description: An opaque dark blue knee-length wool tunic has narrow gold geometric woven borders around the split neckline, cuffs and hem. A cream linen undershirt shows at the neckline, sleeves and lower hem. Two round gold brooches linked by a short chain sit at the upper chest. A brown decorated leather belt with a long hanging strap closes the waist. Brown trousers, dark lower-leg wraps with crossed leather bindings and brown leather ankle boots complete the outfit. Both bare hands are visible; there is no armour, headgear or weapon.
